description: This file contains PHP source code defining classes and functions related to schema management, database objects, and SQL generation within the ADOdb abstraction layer. Its primary purpose is to parse XML schemas, generate SQL statements for creating and modifying database structures, and manage schema versions and upgrades.

classes.name: dbObject
classes.description: An abstract class representing a generic database object with methods for XML parsing callbacks, platform support, and prefix management.

classes.name: dbTable
classes.description: Represents a database table, providing methods to define fields, indexes, generate SQL for creation and upgrade, and handle schema modifications.

classes.name: dbIndex
classes.description: Represents a database index, allowing creation, options setting, and generating SQL to create or drop the index.

classes.name: dbData
classes.description: Manages table data for insertion or update, including building SQL statements based on parsed XML data.

classes.name: dbQuerySet
classes.description: Handles a collection of SQL queries, enabling assembly, prefixing, and creation of executable SQL batch statements.

classes.name: adoSchema
classes.description: Main class for loading, parsing, transforming XML schemas, and generating SQL for database schema creation, upgrade, and removal. Manages schema versions, inline execution, and error handling.

methods.name: setUpgradeMethod
methods.description: Sets or retrieves the strategy for upgrading existing database schemas.

methods.name: existingData
methods.description: Configures how to handle existing data during schema updates (insert, update, or ignore).

methods.name: executeInline
methods.description: Enables or disables inline execution of generated SQL statements.

methods.name: continueOnError
methods.description: Enables or disables continuation of schema processing upon SQL execution errors.

methods.name: parseSchema
methods.description: Loads an XML schema file, converts it into SQL queries, and optionally returns the schema string.

methods.name: parseSchemaString
methods.description: Parses an XML schema string into SQL queries for creating or upgrading a database schema.

methods.name: removeSchema
methods.description: Generates SQL to remove a schema described in an XML schema file.

methods.name: removeSchemaString
methods.description: Generates SQL to uninstall a schema from a database based on an XML schema string.

methods.name: executeSchema
methods.description: Executes the parsed SQL statements to apply the schema to the database.

methods.name: printSQL
methods.description: Returns the generated SQL statements in specified formats such as HTML or plain text.

methods.name: saveSQL
methods.description: Saves the generated SQL array to a file.

methods.name: create_parser
methods.description: Creates and configures an XML parser instance.

methods.name: _tag_open
methods.description: Internal callback for handling XML start tags during schema parsing.

methods.name: _tag_cdata
methods.description: Internal callback for handling character data within XML elements.

methods.name: _tag_close
methods.description: Internal callback for handling XML end tags during schema parsing.

methods.name: convertSchemaString
methods.description: Converts an XML schema string between different DTD versions, optionally writing the result to a file.

methods.name: convertSchemaFile
methods.description: Converts an XML schema file between different DTD versions, optionally saving the converted schema.

methods.name: transformSchema
methods.description: Performs an XSLT transformation on a schema to convert or process its structure.

methods.name: schemaFileVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the schema version from an XML schema file.

methods.name: schemaStringVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the schema version from an XML schema string.
